blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Port Moody Centre. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Port Moody total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Port Moody Centre fell from 21 in June to 15 in October (−28.6%), and 11 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 10.9% of Port Moody’s 138 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Port Moody Centre?
Port Moody Centre also had 116 condos and townhomes listed and 17 sold in October, against 15 houses listed. The Port Moody Centre condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Port Moody Centre home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

11 houses sold in Port Moody Centre with a median price of $1,390,000 (the middle half sold between $1,292,500 and $1,915,000), taking a median of 21 days to sell at 96.0% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $570 per square foot, a median year built of 1969 and a median lot of 7,824 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Port Moody Centre?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 15 houses listed in Port Moody Centre. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Port Moody Centre a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Port Moody Centre had a sales ratio of 13%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Port Moody Centre from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 11 houses sold in Port Moody Centre over those 5 months, out of 64 in all of Port Moody.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Port Moody Centre?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Port Moody Centre sell for?
faq.a: 11 houses sold in Port Moody Centre between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,390,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Port Moody Centre?
faq.a: The median was 21 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.0% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
